about: Documents the eval runs built from eval/prompt.md with only the MCP tools: one per prompt, not minimal, not Java-verified. Shown and searched only on request (include_generated).

examples.prompt: Make a widget showing the current moon phase, tonight's moonrise-style label ("waxing gibbous, 82% lit"), and how many days until the next full moon.
examples.title: Moon phase widget

run.result: good, checked on six dates

run.result: right at every clock checked (London morning, midnight crossings, New Year, a user in Tokyo, DST samples): each city's local time from a host offset in minutes (DST included) and offsetToUtc(), a sun or moon icon (06-18 rule), "+9 h" / "same time" / "· +1 day"; layouts for 4x2, 2x2, 4x1, small and a phone screen with a WorldMap night shade; four looks; once a minute; 38 KB
